title: LockTimeoutDuration in AL
summary: The Database.LockTimeoutDuration method, introduced in Dynamics 365 Business Central 2025 Wave 2 (version 27), lets developers override lock timeout settings in AL code at the statement level. Online environments default to 30 seconds, on-premises to 10 seconds, with a platform maximum of 1.71 million milliseconds (28.5 minutes). Understanding when and how to adjust this value helps prevent timeout errors in business-critical procedures while avoiding deadlocks and blocking chains.
key_points: Database.LockTimeoutDuration was introduced in BC 2025 Wave 2 (v27) to allow per-statement lock timeout overrides in AL code
Online environments have a 30-second default timeout; on-premises defaults to 10 seconds from the $ndo$dbproperty table
Lock timeout values are limited to a maximum of 1.71 million milliseconds (28.5 minutes), which is 10 percent below the command timeout to distinguish between lock and command timeouts
Setting timeout values too low increases timeout errors and rollbacks; setting them too high risks deadlocks and blocking chains
This feature should be used sparingly for specific business-critical procedures that encounter lock timeouts, not as a general solution to locking problems

quotes.text: With great power (define a lock timeout) comes great responsibility (you are accountable of the consequences: good and bad).
quotes.why_it_matters: This emphasizes that using this feature requires careful consideration to avoid introducing deadlocks and performance problems.
